blotato_new_comments_trigger.description: Runs each time a comment is created in Blotato. Ones created before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields accountId, authorId, author.name, author.username, createdAt, errorCode, errorMessage, id, isAuthor, parentCommentId, platform, platformCommentId, platformPostId, postId, status, text

blotato_new_or_updated_comments_trigger.description: Runs for each comment added or changed in Blotato. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields accountId, authorId, author.name, author.username, createdAt, errorCode, errorMessage, id, isAuthor, parentCommentId, platform, platformCommentId, platformPostId, postId, status, text

blotato_new_or_updated_posts_trigger.description: Runs for each post submission added or changed in Blotato. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, postTime, account.id, account.name, account.subaccount.id, account.subaccount.name, state.type, text, mediaUrls, platform

blotato_new_or_updated_schedules_trigger.description: Runs for each scheduled post added or changed in Blotato. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, account.id, account.name, account.username, account.profileImageUrl, account.subaccountId, account.subId, account.subaccountName, draft.accountId, draft.content.text, draft.content.mediaUrls, draft.content.platform, draft.content.additionalPosts, draft.target.targetType, draft.target.url, scheduledAt

blotato_new_posts_trigger.description: Runs each time a post submission is created in Blotato. Ones created before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, postTime, account.id, account.name, account.subaccount.id, account.subaccount.name, state.type, text, mediaUrls, platform
